title: D2: Decide creation-variant policy (variant feats, background customization)
description: feats and customizing-a-background are design-blocked: whether the code-owned character-creation/advancement flow offers variant-feat adoption (with prerequisite tracking) and background customization (swap skill/tool/feature) is a product decision, not a play-time ruling. If yes, small F8-style Codex slices (per docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/2026-07-06-o9bd-18-7-8-execution-boundary-classification.md §4 D2).
notes: Decision implemented: support the SRD optional feat path at ASI levels with prerequisite and once-only enforcement (including Grappler STR 13), and support exact custom-background skill/tool/language/feature/equipment constraints. Variant Human remains unsupported because it is not in SRD 5.1. Creation finalization and level-up are deterministic and source-grounded.
close_reason: Creation-variant policy decided and implemented with deterministic feat/custom-background validation and tests.
